translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Belakamze Mauluke Warekaikene

Kimakopne! Ŋinanoŋine loutneŋo kito ebo ebon misuk okanikei, onoka wane ŋine mo detmami, kito ebo ebon ŋene korop baŋ wano wanok ŋeiŋo wanokŋongi paki kineze ma wakone turuŋine zok manerop umatne ŋeboniake, ŋo natne yauwine eŋe yemo ewekine okanoniake.

Ŋene koropŋo naso baŋem mo masi qotkoine okan okanmaine, ŋo ŋei mane eŋe don raraine eao qotkoine mane mi mamaike, ea weku mane, ŋei yalineŋo maine wet dereret so sola korop warekaki mayakatneka pamaike.
Ŋene horsiŋo donze dere aŋaze tewekeakane ŋetko kiki horsi mane wane aŋaino mot okanmaine, eso ŋene maine maŋem numa diawao ariakane wetkemaine, eaka arimaike.

Me seki mane wane detpi, seki eŋe zok suaine, wane momo togogole ŋo qe modatki kiwetko arimaike, wiliŋaine nigagatne, wane seki welaine eŋe numa diawao ariakane wetkemaike, eaka seki wiliŋaine maingeki arimaike.

Eso belakam wane rokop eŋe wekuka pamaike, eŋe sola korop ea wane sisineine nigagatne, ŋo eŋe solaze kakapa suaine ea wane aŋage zok bokaka okanmaike, so eŋine detki wawaine manerop okanokanmaike. Ŋine gerep ea detkau, eŋe nigagatne, ŋo siluŋ tobo suaine ea zeki paki qe solokki midamaike!

Eso belakam eŋe gerep yale, eamo borikine kine kine ea wane nagaine, eao borikine ŋo mat urum solazo mawareki paki waetne motki solaze so wetze so dereretze korop rokopkemaike, eaŋo gegezane qesiŋ ea korop kiwakki lawe zemaike, gerep eamo sora gerep eŋino ŋine sarimaike, yewaŋo puangi zemaike.
Ŋei eŋe osom natne zubaine maine ma peseoniake, osom zubaine so naŋi, koma so zawon, eŋe yale okane more eŋine bango biraone more oŋom wareoniake.
Ŋo siluŋ ŋei maneŋo belakanmine maine mi ma pesekake, eamo borikine so maine mi ma walukkaikene, seu seu wane soa so zonom borikineŋo watke pamaike.
Ŋene belakam yewaŋo Waom so Magaze ewine kito okanmaine, so belakam yewaŋoka ŋei kimakopze Anutu eŋine kaittoqaine yale ebuke eŋe soakon okanmaine.
Bakom kito kito don so soa don ere aŋa wekuo ŋineka saket okanmamik, kimakop masi iwa misuk wakonikei!
Doku deine wekuo ŋineka doku simile so tabaine ere maine mi sakesikeik.
Kimakop, ŋalok eki maneo wele nemuyap mi qeake; waiŋ mulap maneo wele ŋalok mi qeake, kiwetŋo qein ge doku simile momoine mi okaniake.
Dereret Maine Yemo Wetiŋine Sarimaike

Ŋinane keuŋino ŋei mane wetine lolotne, so dereretinerop gemaike me? Ŋei mane wetine lolotne so dereret korop geakeo, eŋe gegeine mayakatne, wawaine midaine wetne pesekakatne so wetlot korop geake, ge more wet lot korop so dereret korop ea wane kine sikan ongi ŋei eŋe kaikei.
Ŋo wetŋone kotino sori sorin, sot osi osi so bonep nugunge more nema oka okan payakeo, ge solaŋone misuk mawa kaikene paki, isi don ra more don welekatne ea ŋabakaikene.
Dereret yaline eamo weti qeliwoŋine mi sarimaike, eamo kepe wane biŋek, ŋeiwoŋine so satan wanoŋine.
Sori sorin so nugu nugun payake, yewao dinbun wiri wiri so borikine kinekine korop yaleka wakone payake.

Ŋo wet dereret weti qeliwoŋine sarimaike, yemo korop libe libe, so peam gorop, pesekine, so kima kima, wet borikŋo watke pa more kito motki wele tanik manik maine ea wakongi, wet ea mau paki ŋei ŋerep korop tanik wekuka okanonikei, so isi me mawa mawaine misuk okanikei.
Ŋei pesekine gemami, eŋe peam wane waetne ebotpi weleine koboboine gege, ea wakone ebon okanmaike.
